name: University of Antwerp
summary: Flemish research university in Antwerp; two of its 34 bachelor's are in English: social-economic sciences and a European urban sustainability degree.

ib.text: An IB Diploma verifiable on IBIS gives direct access. IB with English passed at 'Language 1 (min. 5) or Level A (min. 3)' exempts you from an English test; otherwise IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 80.

dates.label: Admission application, if you must file one: documents uploaded (non-EEA)
Admission application, if you must file one: documents uploaded (EEA)
Legalised or certified documents reach the registrar (EEA)

programmes.name: Social-Economic Sciences
programmes.ib: Maths proficiency recommended; the compulsory maths test applies to non-EEA degrees, and UAntwerp treats the IB as an EEA degree. Four majors from year 2.

programmes.name: Urban Sustainability Studies
programmes.ib: YUFE joint degree of 10 European universities: apply on the YUFE Virtual Campus, choosing Antwerp as starting university. 2027 deadlines not yet published.

notes: With an IB and no visa needed, you skip the admission application and enrol directly from July; the deadlines above are for applicants who must file one.
The other bachelor's are taught in Dutch: you need ITNA B2 (C1 for language programmes), or an IB with Dutch passed at Language 1 grade 5 or Level A grade 3.
